description: Foundry VTT screenshot showing a "Catlike" Quality item's Effects/Changes panel layered over an open Sneaking Test roll dialog. The Catlike effect's Changes tab lists one change: Attribute Key "data.pool", Change Mode "Custom", Value 2, Priority 0, and its Apply-To is set to "Test". Behind it, the Sneaking Test dialog for "Covert Ops Specialist (Incomplete)" shows Pool 11 with a +2 bump from a "Chameleon Suit" item on Limit, but no bonus at all from the Catlike effect on Pool — i.e. the effect's dice-pool bonus is not being applied to the roll.
